title: 2196. Finding the Average of N Numbers
description:

. 
Finding the Average of N Numbers
20
Easy
Problem Statement
Read a count N followed by N integers and print their average with two decimal places, using a loop and type casting.
Description
Read an integer N, then read N integers one at a time using a for loop and add each of them to a running sum. After the loop, divide the sum by N to find the average. Since dividing two integers drops the decimal part, convert the sum to float using (float) before dividing. Print the average with exactly two digits after the decimal point.
Input Description
An integer N (N >= 1), followed by N integers, all separated by spaces.
Output Description
Print the average of the N numbers with two digits after the decimal point.
Sample Input
4 10 20 30 40
Sample Output
25.00
